title: Hot-route protection: dashboards + burn-rate alerts for throttling, lane utilization, and top-route saturation
author: Sergio Costa
description: Context: As part of hot-route capacity protection, we need a consistent set of dashboards and alerts that answer (1) are we shedding traffic, (2) are enterprise lanes healthy, and (3) are specific routes saturating the fleet. This PR adds Grafana dashboards + Prometheus alert rules for throttling rate, lane utilization, and top-route saturation, and routes pages to #eng-oncall when enterprise SLO risk is detected. Scope: Hosted API + Dedicated (where applicable); metrics are sourced from gateway + router + runtime backpressure signals. Notes: This intentionally avoids per-tenant labels for cardinality; dashboards are keyed by route_id, tier, region, and model_family per the review in the observability cardinality meeting. Rollout: dashboards land immediately; alerts default to 'disabled' via Alertmanager route muting until SRE enables in canary regions. Related: ENG-4827 (metrics), ENG-4829 (load tests). Confluence dashboard spec: /eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/hot-route-capacity-protection-dashboards. Checklist: [x] Adds overview + per-route drilldowns [x] Adds SLO-ish burn rate alerts for enterprise lane errors + latency [x] Adds throttling spike alerts with suppression during planned load tests [x] Ensures labels/cardinality within budget [x] Alert routing to #eng-oncall with runbook links and incident-bot compatibility
commits: dashboards: add Hot Route Protection overview + lane utilization drilldown
alerts: throttling spike + enterprise lane burn-rate alerts (multiwindow)
observability: add recording rules for route/tier aggregates to reduce query cost
docs: update dashboard index + runbook links in alert annotations
chore: align label naming (route_id vs route) and add unit tests for rule files
checks: CI: build (pass) · lint (pass) · jsonnet-eval (pass) · prometheus-rule-tests (pass) · grafana-schema-validate (pass) · link-check (pass). Perf note: Added recording rules to keep dashboard queries <2s at 30d range; verified in staging Prometheus w/ 1h scrape.

release_notes: Adds Hot Route Protection Grafana dashboards (overview, enterprise lane health, per-route drilldown) and Prometheus alerting (throttling spikes, saturation signals, enterprise lane burn-rate). Severity=page alerts route to #eng-oncall and include runbook + dashboard links; paging is intended to be enabled region-by-region during rollout.
